{{Top}}
{{Otheruses}}
[[File:Starfighter_size_chart.png|thumb|right|250px|Size comparison of various starfighters used during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]]]
{{Quote|Blast! This is why I hate flying!|[[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]], being chased by [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett's]] [[Slave I/Legends|''Slave I'']]|<ref name="Episode 2">{{Film|II}}</ref>}}
A '''starfighter''', or simply a '''fighter''', was a small, maneuverable [[Starship/Legends|starship]] designed for [[Starfighter combat/Legends|combat]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:Starfighters-SWE.png|thumb|left|250px|Various starfighter models]]
The majority of starfighters were [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] directly by [[Species/Legends|living beings]], although some were controlled either remotely or by [[Artificial intelligence/Legends|artificial intelligence]]. These light craft were designed to carry out attacks on sensitive installations and targets that required immense precision.

In [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] battle, starfighters worked in concert with [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ships]], harassing [[Warship/Legends|warships]] and striking once their weakened [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]] failed<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref><ref name="SW:CL">[[Star Wars: Complete Locations (2005)|''Star Wars: Complete Locations'']]</ref> or were re-aligned<ref name="SOTE">''[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (comic series)|Shadows of the Empire (comics)]]''</ref><ref name="X:TBW">''[[X-Wing: The Bacta War]]''</ref> due to enemy capital-[[Starship/Legends|ship]] [[Laser/Legends|fire]]. Alone, fighters had little to no chance of penetrating the shields of capital ships,<ref name="TPM">{{Film|I}}</ref> but most starfighters worked in [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] and carried weapons like [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] and [[Concussion missile/Legends|concussion missiles]]. These squadrons could take out a large capital ship with precision fire directed at weak points that might otherwise be hard to target (such as a [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]] or the ship's [[Bridge (starship)/Legends|bridge]]).

==Behind the scenes==
[[Star Wars (1977) 1|''Star Wars'' (1977) 1]] refers to the [[Tantive IV/Legends|''Tantive IV'']] as a starfighter. This is inconsistent with how the term has come to be used in subsequent literature.
